description: This file defines a function to extract an audio mode tag from a given text input. It supports the [[audio_as_voice]] directive to indicate whether the audio should be sent as a voice message rather than a file. The function leverages an imported utility to parse inline directives in the text.

methods.name: export function parseAudioTag(text?: string): { parseAudioTag
methods.description: Extracts audio-related tags and options from the provided text, returning an object indicating whether the text contained directives and whether the audio should be sent as a voice message.
